label: Tag run
description: Put tags on this run so a later run can stop it. Every input wired onto the node is a tag, and a `tags` list works too; the two add up. Any string works as a tag: unsafe characters are replaced and a short fingerprint is added, so two different values never share a tag. Pair with `StopTagged` when a new event should stop the work already in flight.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags as one list, for when they come from a node that already built the list. Wired inputs of your own are tags too; the two add up.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the tags are on the run. Wire it into the `_should_flow` of what must happen only after tagging, `StopTagged` first.
